Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4369, Claude Fable 5.2 (claude-fable-5-2), mkinney seat (`.claude-mkinney`); did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: ready for the maintainer to merge.** There are no blocking findings.

This is the first review of this PR. The earlier comment from the host `skull` is not a review: that host could not build. This review is the safety tier, because issue #3513 puts the work under the safety floor. The PR changes no product code, no posted G-code, no check and no recorded program. It changes one test file and adds one decision file.

## What looks good

- The assert body of `the_3d_finish_band_generates_with_no_gouge` has no change. Each of the 12 bands asserts the same items as each of the 6 old bands: generate `ok`, a full verify gate, no gouge, `gate.ok`, a blocking `shank_hit`, `ok == false` and `held_by == ["S1"]`.
- The coverage of the Z span is the same. `EDGES` starts at 0 and ends at `PARTS`, and adjacent bands share their edge. The test `the_3d_finish_bands_tile_the_whole_span` did not change and it holds this.
- The `#[test]` count of the file goes from 8 to 15. The ignored set goes from 6 to 12. No assert is weaker.
- The test binary is not split, and there is no new top-level test file.
- No other file names the old `..._of_6_...` tests (`xtask/`, docs and site were searched).
- The file has 385 lines.
- The body has the readings before and after, the `Changelog:` line, "Goldens moved: None" and `Fixes #3513`. The commit subject is conventional.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/3513-reband-shared-face-finish.md` has the heading, the decision, the reason, the dropped options and the cost.

## Results, merged with main

Built and run locally on the host `m3` (16 CPUs), in the worktree `.claude/worktrees/review-4369`. The trial merge of head `efd49acdc` with `upstream/main` `d38fd5421` is clean (no conflict).

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` : `app suites: shared_face_bodies_finish` | ok, 3 passed, 0 failed, 12 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --only "app heavy: shared_face_bodies_finish"` (release, `--ignored`, `--test-threads=16`) | ok, 12 passed, 0 failed, 56.96 s for the test run |
| `cargo xtask gate light` (6 steps) | ok, 0 failed |

The heavy step is not a merge condition for a `P5` PR. It ran because issue #3513 asks for a green heavy lane, and because only this step shows that each new band has a `shank_hit` finding.

Extra suites run: none are owed. The diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no import code. The example catalog suites did not run here: the diff changes no post, operation, motion or catalog file. The author's body reports that suite as green.

Not measured here: the time of each band alone. This review confirms the wall time of the whole step (57 s on 16 CPUs, against 70.6 s and 64.3 s in the body). It does not confirm the 2.0x ratio of the single bands.

## Mutations (run by this review, the file restored after each)

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| `EDGES` as equal twelfths (`0, 4, 8, ... 48`) | red: `band 1 in the fast upper half starts at the model's top` |
| Last band `44..48` (4 parts) | red: `band 11 in the slow lower half is too wide` |
| First edge `1`, and a repeated edge `30, 30` | red in two tests: `the_3d_finish_bands_tile_the_whole_span` (top offset is not 0) and the pin test (`band 0 in the fast upper half starts at the model's top`) |
| Restored | green (the quick gate result above is on the restored tree; `git status` is clean) |

The first two are the mutations that the body names. They give the same messages as the body.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

1. `crates/app/tests/shared_face_bodies_finish.rs:160` - the `const` assert holds only the length of `EDGES`. A removed `band!` line is not found by it. The old code had the same limit.
2. `docs/decisions/3513-reband-shared-face-finish.md:16` - the old bands 1 to 3 read 11.8, 6.8 and 11.6 s (sum 969 s). The PR body gives 12.1, 7.4 and 13.0 s (sum 971 s). The two can agree at the next push, if there is one.
3. The body says that old band 4 (559 s) against its eight parts (247 s) can be a performance defect of the 3D Finish level ladder. No issue tracks it. The merging session can file it (`P7`, `area:motion`) if the maintainer wants it.

## Labels and state

- The PR is `MERGEABLE`. This review sets `merge-ready`.
- The PR is a draft of the account `mkinney`. This author-side review flags it ready after this comment.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
